canonicalName: Probabilistic construction of Liouville conformal field theory

milestones.label: Polyakov's quantum geometry of bosonic strings
milestones.work: Polyakov, A. M., Quantum geometry of bosonic strings, Phys. Lett. B 103, 1981
milestones.description: Polyakov writes the path integral over metrics that gives the Liouville action, the physics object the probabilistic construction later makes rigorous.

evidence.claim: Article in Physics Letters B, 1981 (DOI 10.1016/0370-2693(81)90743-7)
Liouville theory's path integral was difficult to define and compute; its rigorous construction came in the 2010s

milestones.note: Precursor: a physics formulation, not a rigorous probabilistic statement.

milestones.label: Multiplicative chaos
milestones.work: Kahane, J.-P., Sur le chaos multiplicatif, Ann. Sci. Math. Québec 9, 1985
milestones.description: Kahane introduces multiplicative chaos, the random measure construction used to define the Liouville measure.

evidence.claim: The journal's own table of contents records Kahane's Sur le chaos multiplicatif in volume 9(2), December 1985, pp. 105–150.
evidence.source: Annales des sciences mathématiques du Québec

milestones.note: Year confirmed in zbMATH (1985 entries for the 1985 note); the journal reference is not confirmed in the record.

milestones.label: Liouville quantum gravity on the Riemann sphere
milestones.work: David, F., Kupiainen, A., Rhodes, R., Vargas, V., Liouville quantum gravity on the Riemann sphere, Comm. Math. Phys., 2016
milestones.description: The 2016 paper constructs the Liouville path integral probabilistically on the sphere, the first purposeful use of the chaos tools on the physics object.

evidence.claim: Article in Comm. Math. Phys., 2016 (DOI 10.1007/s00220-016-2572-4)
A rigorous probabilistic construction of the path integral was found in the 2010s

milestones.note: 'First' is judged from the Wikipedia dating in the 2010s; no other earlier probabilistic construction was checked.
